scope: Exact saved memory Maestro flow spawn results only. This audit does not establish capture validity or reclassify any run.
selection: Two completed 90000 ms references, the completed 120000 ms carousel-expanding-06 reference and matched carousel-idle-expanding-03 control, and three explicitly rejected attempts.
cleanRecordedResultDefinition: status === 0, signal === null, errorCode === null, timedOut === false; all four are required. A clean flow result alone does not validate UUIDs, caches, checkpoints, process identity, or the whole capture.
limitations: Only existing *-result.json records are audited. An interrupted flow with no result file has no inferred status.
Older 60000 ms captures without precise flow result files remain unaudited for spawn errors; exit status or log completion alone cannot recreate missing result.error evidence.
DurationMs is the recorded host elapsed duration. Preserve its precision; do not infer timedOut from comparing duration with timeoutMs.
Rejected attempts remain rejected even when every retained flow result is clean. Original verdicts are summarized and hashed separately.

older60000MsCaptures.scope: Earlier capture protocol, including the initial expanding carousel prewarm rejection. No retrospective clean-result claim is made.
